name: Feed Dedup
description: Hides duplicate feeds of the same iptv-org channel (tvg-id channel@feed). Pick the feed to keep per channel in the dropdowns below, or leave it on Automatic: alive first, then the iptv-org main feed, then a feed broadcast in the preferred country, then the lowest channel number. Runs after every M3U refresh and every hour at :25 and only unhides channels it hid itself.
author: local

fields.label: Dead-channel group
fields.help_text: Channels in this group (IPTV Checker's dead group) count as dead and lose against alive feeds.

fields.label: Preferred country
fields.help_text: ISO code. When no main feed is present, a feed broadcast in this country wins.

actions.label: Preview
actions.description: Show which channels would be hidden or unhidden. Changes nothing.

actions.label: Apply
actions.description: Hide duplicate feeds now and arm the hourly schedule. Also runs after every M3U refresh.

actions.label: Undo all
actions.description: Unhide every channel this plugin has hidden and stop the schedule.

confirm.message: Unhide every channel Feed Dedup has hidden?
